```{r}

all_awqms <- read_excel('~/BioMonORDEQ/Benchmarks/Water Chemistry/cal.val_chem.ref.wq_2026-05-14.xlsx') %>%  # Output file from ref benchmarks script 
  select(c(MLocID, Project1, StationDes, Lat_DD, Long_DD, SampleStartDate, L2Eco, L3Eco, EcoRegion4, HUC8, ReferenceSite, cal_val, COMID)) 

# Convert character columns to factors
all_awqms[sapply(all_awqms, is.character)] <- lapply(all_awqms[sapply(all_awqms, is.character)], as.factor)

# Order factors
all_awqms$L2Eco <- factor(all_awqms$L2Eco, levels = c("Marine West Coast Forest", "Western Cordillera", "Cold Deserts"))
all_awqms$L3Eco <- factor(all_awqms$L3Eco, levels = c("Coast Range", "Willamette Valley", "Klamath Mountains", "Cascades", "Eastern Cascades Slopes and Foothills", "Columbia Plateau","Blue Mountains", "Northern Basin and Range", "Snake River Plain"))
all_awqms$ReferenceSite <- factor(all_awqms$ReferenceSite, levels = c("REFERENCE", "MODERATELY DISTURBED", "MOST DISTURBED"))

comids <- all_awqms %>% 
  select(COMID) %>% 
  distinct()# Get just the COMIDs for next step

```

```{r streamcat flat file}
sc_all <- read_excel("~/BioMonORDEQ/Benchmarks/Water Chemistry/SC_all_comids_2026-05-14.xlsx")
sc_all <- inner_join(sc_all, comids)  # only keep TN COMIDs.

# add in rp100 metrics and % forest
deq_sc_rp100 <- read_csv(r"(\\deqlab1\\BioMon\\Projects\\Biomon Redux\\StreamCat data June 2026\\wsrp100.csv)", 
                         col_select = c(comid,minedenswsrp100,tridenswsrp100,superfunddenswsrp100)) %>% 
  filter(comid %in% comids$COMID)

sc_all <- sc_all %>% 
  full_join(deq_sc_rp100, by = join_by("COMID" == "comid")) %>% 
  mutate(PCTFOREST2001 = rowSums(across(c(PCTCONIF2001WS, PCTDECID2001WS, PCTMXFST2001WS)))) # Create pctforest var.
```

```{r}
# ERODIBLE VS RESISTENT GEOLOGY (KEPT ERODIBLE, SINCE RESISTENT IS INVERSE OF ERODIBLE)
erod_resist_strmpow <- sc_all %>%
  mutate(PCT_EROD = PCTALLUVCOASTWS+PCTCARBRESIDWS+PCTCOASTCRSWS+PCTCOLLUVSEDWS+PCTEOLCRSWS+PCTEOLFINEWS+PCTGLACLAKECRSWS+PCTGLACLAKEFINEWS+PCTGLACTILCLAYWS+PCTGLACTILCRSWS+PCTGLACTILLOAMWS+PCTSALLAKEWS+PCTNONCARBRESIDWS)  %>% 
  mutate(PCT_RESIST = PCTALKINTRUVOLWS+PCTEXTRUVOLWS+PCTHYDRICWS+PCTSILICICWS) 

# SLOPE FROM NHD (TAKES 1-2 MIN)
# Note: do NOT push the downloaded file to GitHub as it's too large and will result in issues. Commit the ignore instead.
erod_resist_strmpow <- ORDEQBioassessment::get_NHD_info(erod_resist_strmpow) 

# WATERSHED AREA AND STREAM POWER
erod_resist_strmpow <- erod_resist_strmpow %>% 
  mutate(STRMPOW_CAT = totdasqkm + PRECIP9120WS * slope) %>%  # WSAREASQKM from SC, instead pulling totdasqkm from get_NHD (they are the same)
  select(COMID, PCT_EROD, STRMPOW_CAT, NHD_pSLOPE, SITE_TYPE) # Drop PCT_RESIST since it's the inverse of PCT_ERODE

vars <- sc_all %>% 
  inner_join(erod_resist_strmpow, by='COMID') %>% # Join StreamCat data with erod_resist_strmpow data calulated above
  right_join(all_awqms, by = 'COMID') %>% 
  distinct(COMID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  relocate(MLocID:cal_val, .before = COMID) %>% 
  select(-c(MLocID:SampleStartDate,EcoRegion4:HUC8,cal_val,COMID))
```

vars2 <- vars %>% 
  select(L3Eco, where(is.numeric)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -L3Eco, names_to = "numeric_var", values_to = "value") %>% 
  mutate(value = log(value+1), .keep = "unused")

ggplot(vars2, aes(x=L3Eco, y = value)) +
